{{Quote|I was reading up on this light bridge tech, it's really fascinating. Sturdier than conventional materials too, unless you have a power outage&hellip;|Mako|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
A '''light bridge''' or '''lightbridge''' was a type of technology that generated solid-light walkways sturdy enough to stand on and cross. The energy of a light bridge could withstand even a small army of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="hitting the hutts">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Hitting the Hutts|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] used light bridges to connect its many mesas.<ref name="makeb" /> The technology also saw use on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], specifically in the facility on the [[Lost Island]].<ref name="ord mantell" />
